## Strict Skill & Mode Constraints
- When the user explicitly invokes `/grill-me` or `/grill-with-docs`, you are strictly prohibited from generating a `plan.md` file or invoking the native Plan Mode workflow.
- follow the rules as set out in the `/grill-me` or `/grill-with-docs` protocol exactly.
- Follow Matt Pocock's `grill-me` or `/grill-with-docs` protocol exactly: ask one specific design or architecture question at a time in the chat stream, and wait for the user's manual text response before proceeding.
